description: Header file defining a ThreadPool class with nested interfaces, job management, scheduling, and worker thread classes for a multithreaded task execution system.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, job scheduling, and execution with support for priorities and monitoring.

classes.name: ThreadPool::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback when the thread pool is idle.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IJob
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be resubmitted.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling jobs at specific times.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for initializing, deinitializing, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Metadata
classes.description: Struct containing information about a worker thread.

classes.name: ThreadPool::DispatchedJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for monitoring dispatched jobs (warning reporting enabled).

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType
classes.description: Template class representing a job with internal state management and resubmission logic.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity that processes jobs from the queue.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: Thread class that runs a Minion to process jobs.

methods.name: Resubmit
methods.description: Resubmits a job for execution, possibly after a delay.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specific time.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop for a Minion or Executor.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Handles completion of a job, possibly rescheduling.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Callback when the thread pool is idle.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Attempts to revoke a job from the queue or execution.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the queue with optional priority.

methods.name: WaitForStop
methods.description: Waits for all threads to stop.

methods.name: HasThreadID
methods.description: Checks if a thread ID is part of the pool.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a thread ID as active.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a thread ID from active set.
